digest.component_or_area: Jira write dispatch and retry budget (S1 proof-of-concept)
propositions: Summary-only writes to Jira Cloud and DC must be executed through a single provider-neutral operation/outcome contract with stable logical id, desired postcondition, bounded invocation count (≤3), cumulative sleep budget (≤15s), and deterministic retry schedule.
Jira has no idempotency key; recovery must observe desired state before replay and distinguish conclusive success, inconclusive ambiguity, and permanent failure without retrying after timeout.

Cloud executor uses ACLI process per write with sanitized exit/stdout/stderr decoding; summary recovery uses primary-store REST GET with one attempt and no sleep, preserving existing caller retry behavior.

DC executor is constructed with jira.JIRA(..., max_retries=0) and uses exactly GET→PUT→GET invocation per write with fail-fast unless _session.max_retries == 0; per-call policies apply one-attempt/no-sleep to selected pre/post reads.

Every terminal outcome emits exactly one redacted per-mutation error/disposition message (≤512 Unicode code points) and one completion log (≤1024 code points total) containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and message.
Production defaults to legacy internal selector; S1 is test-only with explicit executor selection; S3 owns venue-gated validation and default cutover; no config/env surface or dual-send.
